_doc: Starlark. ref_cmd: only load() names a file (include) and symbols (ref). path_sub.include: a Bazel label is a path, //pkg:f.bzl is pkg/f.bzl, :f.bzl is f.bzl in the directory of the file, @repo//... is another repository and names nothing of ours.
